gamerule.shifting-wares.allow_persistent: Allow peristent trades (e.g: exploration maps) to be rerolled, if they have been used at least once.
gamerule.shifting-wares.daily_reroll.des: Villagers will reroll all their offers once per day.
gamerule.shifting-wares.deplete_reroll.d: Villagers will never refill their offers. Instead, those are rerolled after being completely depleted.
gamerule.shifting-wares.workstation_prot: Prevents rerolling trades by breaking and replacing a villager's workstation.
